title: Until Then
lyrics: [F7]My heart can [Bb]sing when I pause to [F7]remember,
A heartache [F]here is but a stepping [Bb]stone.
But until [Cm]then, my [F7]heart will go on [Bb]singing,
The things of earth will dim and loose there value, (TJU <- "lose their"?)
If we recall they're borrowed for awhile;
And things of earth that cause the heart to tremble,
Remember there, will only bring a smile.
